title: Last Light on the Lake
invitation: Find Mara under the boardwalk before the Game Corner closes.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Game Corner is paying out. Every time coins hit the tray upstairs, something rattles the wire under the boards.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: There. A Krabby. See the claw? It’s too swollen to come through. The slip's clipped right above it.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: When the bell goes, the guard comes back. I can lift the pen if you want to get it open. Or I'll get you close enough for the slip.

choices.label: Take the weigh-slip
choices.reply: The slip puts three live loads on L-06, bound for Bay Nine. You take a copy. Mara goes for the warden with the slip pressed flat inside her jacket.

choices.label: Open the floating pen
choices.detail: Free the Krabby before the guard returns.
choices.reply: The Krabby pulls itself onto Mara’s empty tackle box and hangs on with its good claw. While she carries it to the station, the returning guard takes down the weigh-slip.

echoes.text: Mara has read the call log enough to know where the crease goes. “There. He asked them to stop. He didn’t ask for permission.”
Mara wipes the gate marker with her cuff. “L-06. Same as the waybill. Put the full weight next to where he wrote Empty.”

secret.title: The Second Weighing
secret.hint: Check the second weight on the slip against the Route 6 record.
secret.text: The pen weighed more after the truck left. The number that would account for the difference is on the guard’s copy. Someone has covered it with the open-circle stamp.

title: The Light in Bay Nine
invitation: Nera is waiting in the one booth still lit at Bay Nine.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: A strip of light leaks under Bay Nine’s shutter. Near the floor, the bottom rail has a line of scratches where somebody could fit their fingers through.

panels.speaker: Freight intercom
panels.text: Night sweep in progress. First gate secured.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Nera takes a tape sleeve from beneath her mug. Two different times are written on it, one in pencil and one in pen.

panels.speaker: Nera Vale
panels.text: Ivo asked me to hold on to this. I told the shelter crew I'd get their door open before the sweep. I thought I'd have more time.

choices.label: Save the recording
choices.detail: Take Ivo’s tape before the next sweep.
choices.reply: You save the recording. Ivo barely raises his voice. “I’m going to the old relay on the pass. I won’t give them my name over a freight radio.”

choices.label: Warn the shelter crew
choices.detail: Give the shelter crew time to get out.
choices.reply: You catch the last volunteer at the door. They turn back for the blankets. “Ivo took the path to the old relay. We left him a lamp. If you see him, tell him we got out.”

echoes.text: Nera puts your weigh-slip beside the sleeve. “Same pen over the numbers. Look at the way it skips.” She moves her chair to face the glass.
Mara has sent a picture of the Krabby eating from a saucer. Nera holds the phone at arm’s length, then brings it closer. Before she hands it back, she points out the unbolted side door.

secret.title: An Hour Early
secret.hint: Compare the two times on the recording sleeve with the Lakeside slip.
secret.text: The truck gets to Bay Nine an hour after the release call. You wind the tape back to the arrival. While somebody reads the bay number, Ivo asks for three bowls of water.

title: One Call Before Dark
invitation: The lookout saw someone strike a match inside the locked relay hut.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: From behind the door, two knocks. Ivo lets you in and sets the lamp on the floor. He’s pulled his sleeve over the skin where the freight tag rubbed it raw.

panels.speaker: Ivo
panels.text: Mara sent you? I told her there was a stair under the cathedral. Here, behind the dial. I’ll meet you down there if we get separated.

panels.speaker: Ivo
panels.text: If I call in my own name, they’ll have to record it. If we warn the hikers, they can get off the pass. I need you to pick a channel. I keep looking at both.

choices.label: Record Ivo’s distress call
choices.detail: Use the last transmission to put his name on record.
choices.reply: Ivo gives his name twice. “Seventeen seventeen.” He writes 17:17 on the relay copy and signs it. “Leave the people on the stairs out of this. They’ll tell it when they’re ready.”

choices.label: Broadcast the trail warning
choices.detail: Use the last transmission to warn the hikers.
choices.reply: A trail light blinks back through the snow, then another. Ivo pockets the blank relay copy. When the hikers reach the turn, his is the first lamp they see.

echoes.text: Ivo hears his own voice on the Bay Nine tape. He takes the headphones off. “I thought there was a man right behind me the whole time. Was there?”
A blanket plugs the crack in the window. “The crew you warned brought it up,” Ivo says. He tucks one loose corner back into the frame.

secret.title: The Names Behind the Numbers
secret.hint: Match the Bay Nine voice log to the numbers on Ivo’s map.
secret.text: The bay numbers on the log are marked over the old shelters. Next to each number, Ivo has put a name. In the margin he’s written the way in. Cathedral stair. Knock twice. Wait.
